# Disabled historical workflows

The native-check workflow was moved here unchanged on September 29, 2026 under Josh's standing no-testing instruction (P7). Files outside `.github/workflows/` are not active GitHub workflows.

Do not move it back, dispatch it, add another testing workflow, or use its commands as an implementation checklist. Existing tests and this configuration are preserved as historical material. Current stages end with user-owned manual guides; see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).
